task_description: Major upgrade of Telegram Mail Shop Bot with modern UI/UX, new user features (VIP badges, trending, favorites, repeat orders, restock notifications, search, order tracking, stats), new admin features (real-time analytics, low stock alerts, price sync, auto import, roles, advanced search, transaction export, status manager, profit calc, activity logs), and comprehensive UI modernization (inline keyboards, dark theme formatting, live widgets).

verification.summary: AST parse passes. All existing core functions and buttons preserved. 396 functions across 9616 lines. All 9 routers wired in build_dp(). Runtime bugs from v1 review (nav_deposit state, restock Bot.get_current, nav_home identity, dead-end state, dead button, profit calc) all fixed and verified. Referral system properly accounts commissions as shop revenue cost.
